title: Sleek
description: Just the essentials. No more, no less.
body:
# Sleek
A modpack with the few mods you need to get the framerate you deserve, but not anything you weren't looking for. **All that's present here are performance mods and shader support.**

This modpack is intended for those looking to keep their game as close to vanilla as possible, or to be used as a base for other modpacks. Features are not the goal here. 

It's as bare bones as you can get. That's what makes it special.
